C_commodore_ilyra_venn.name: Commodore Ilyra Venn
C_commodore_ilyra_venn.notes: Voice: Calm, deliberate, ceremonial but not aloof. Speaks in the rhythms of Fleet oaths. Rarely raises her voice; authority comes from steadiness. Arc: From a by-the-book commander to someone willing to defy Admiralty doctrine to protect civilians and allies (her ceasefire in Ep.11).

C_admiral_cael_dominion.name: Admiral Cael Dominion
C_admiral_cael_dominion.role: Fleet Admiralty — Architect of projection doctrine
C_admiral_cael_dominion.notes: Voice: Formal, lofty, often quotes scripture-like maxims. A living embodiment of Memory. Arc: He champions the blockade and ceremony, but loses sway as officers like Venn prove that survival requires humility.

C_varra_cindral.name: Varra Cindral
C_varra_cindral.role: Shards — Warlord of the Scythe of Cindral
C_varra_cindral.notes: Voice: Sharp, direct, pragmatic. Hates wasted words. Arc: Rises as Bloc leader, only to see it fracture at Shatterforge Spire (Ep.10). Missing after Ep.11 — fate unresolved.

C_elyra_vorn.name: Elyra Vorn
C_elyra_vorn.notes: Voice: Sparse speech, cutting honesty, weary of ideology. Arc: From cynical survivor to bridge-figure, quietly making first outreach to Fleet.

C_sira_red_fang.name: Sira Red Fang
C_sira_red_fang.notes: Voice: Loud, brash, mocking. Thrives in fire and chaos. Arc: A force of chaos. Defies Varra, clashes with Elyra, nearly rams Thunderbreak in Ep.11. Survives, but broken.

C_governor_halev.name: Governor Halev
C_governor_halev.role: Verge — Civil leader of Auric Bazaar
C_governor_halev.notes: Voice: Plainspoken, pragmatic. Talks in terms of fields, docks, and people, not grand ideals. Arc: From cautious governor to broker of the Shattered Accord in Ep.12.

C_captain_nira_sol.name: Captain Nira Sol
C_captain_nira_sol.notes: Voice: Blunt, sharp, proud. Hates being treated as a passenger to Fleet protection. Arc: From resentful to respected; Verge escorts prove themselves at Auric Gate (Ep.11).

C_jex_marrin.name: Jex Marrin
C_jex_marrin.notes: Voice: Smooth, sardonic. Every word is a transaction. Arc: Assassination attempt survivor (Ep.9), emerges indispensable, hated but untouchable.

C_elder_branth.name: Elder Branth
C_elder_branth.notes: Voice: Dry, muttering, sarcastic. Arc: Profits throughout, survives everything, represents amoral commerce.

C_vorric_malvek.name: Vorric Malvek
C_vorric_malvek.notes: Voice: Charismatic, bombastic, loves being seen as the people’s savior. Arc: Breaks the blockade at Tal Corvus (Ep.4), hailed as folk hero. Reputation rises, but Elyra warns his glory is a death sentence for civilians.

C_silent_triarch.name: Silent Triarch
C_silent_triarch.role: Confederacy — masked council at Tal Corvus
C_silent_triarch.notes: Voice: Sparse, deliberate. Each word lands like a decree. Arc: Dismiss Varra as crown-seeker, clash openly at Spire (Ep.10). One mask struck in Varra’s duel, undermining aura of invincibility.

C_luminara_mother.name: Luminara Mother
C_luminara_mother.role: Verge — Civilian family, symbolic of wider stakes
C_luminara_mother.notes: Protective Verge civilian parent; fatigue and dignity anchor the civilian stakes.

C_luminara_boy.name: Luminara Boy
C_luminara_boy.role: Verge — Civilian family, symbolic of wider stakes
C_luminara_boy.notes: Curious Verge child whose questions expose the moral stakes adults obscure.

C_archivist_selen_stormwell.name: Archivist Selen Stormwell
C_archivist_selen_stormwell.role: Fleet — Keeper of Memory, Stormwell Archive
C_archivist_selen_stormwell.notes: Voice: Calm, deliberate, voice like liturgy. Anchors ceremony. Arc: Opens the season with Shattering testimony; reappears in Ep.12, inscribing names from Auric Gate — Fleet, Verge, Shard alike.
